description: Digitize physical mail and extract urgency, deadlines, tasks.
notes: Kit fallback at ../kit-fallback-w9.js; real date/amount regex extraction, urgency heuristic

notes.note: Paper mail is where deadlines die — true. But the product needs scanned mail as input, and nobody scans their own mail; the mail-scanning partnerships cost $20+/mo, which breaks the $6/mo consumer math. The input problem kills it: this is a services business wearing an app costume.
Letter selection + urgency sort work; zero errors.

notes.change: Add-deadline-to-calendar now downloads a real .ics file for the letter's extracted deadline instead of a fake toast.
